'''Santa hats''' are tradeable cosmetic items obtained by completing one of the [[Christmas event|Christmas]] [[holiday events]] that occur once per year.

==Trivia==
*The Santa hat uses the default error examine info of "''It's a [Item name]''", as Jagex forgot to add any examine details during the ''RuneScape 2'' Beta. The same oversight occurred with the [[Scythe (Halloween event)|scythe]].
*In ''[[RuneScape Classic]]'', this item was named "Santa's hat" and gave a +3 [[Magic]] bonus when equipped.
*Santa hats are infamous in RuneScape history, dating back to ''RuneScape Classic'' when they were first introduced to the game during the 2002 Christmas Event. Due to the fact this was the ''only'' time a supply of them was added to the game, they quickly became rare items worth hundreds of thousands to millions of gold in the years to come. While Santa hats varied wildly in perceived value, raising or dropping by millions of gold in just a few days time, they could go for over 100 million a few years into ''RuneScape 2''.

==Previous ways to obtain==
Santa hats were first obtainable on [[2 August]] [[2013]], in the [[Falador Party Room]]. There were multiple ways of obtaining them there: either by depositing [[coins]], [[Easter egg]]s or [[pumpkin]]s into the chest, then pulling the lever. The maximum amount of Santa hats that would ever spawn at once was 5.

Coins:
*Inserting 150k coins = 1 Santa hat every other pull (you must put in 150k coins each pull)
*Inserting 300k coins = 1 Santa hat every pull
*Inserting 600k coins = 2 Santa hats every pull
*Inserting 900k coins = 3 Santa hats every pull
*Inserting 1200k coins = 4 Santa hats every pull
''Inserting any more than 1200k coins would still yield only 4 Santa hats per pull.''

Easter eggs:
*Inserting 1 [[Easter egg]] = 2 Santa hats every other pull
*Inserting 2 [[Easter egg]]s = 3 Santa hats every other pull
*Inserting 3 [[Easter egg]]s = 4 Santa hats every other pull
*Inserting 4 [[Easter egg]]s = 5 Santa hats every pull
''Inserting any more than 4 Easter eggs would still yield only 5 Santa hats per pull.''

Pumpkins:
*Inserting 1 [[Pumpkin]] = 4 Santa hats every other pull
*Inserting 2 [[Pumpkin]]s = 5 Santa hats every other pull
''Inserting any more than 2 pumpkins would still yield only 5 Santa hats per pull.''

secondaryExcerpts:
[[File:Crystal crown (Ithell) detail.png|left|150px]]
[[File:Crystal crown (Ithell) chathead.png|left]]
The '''crystal crown''' is a purely cosmetic crown purchasable from the [[Lliann's Wares]] in [[Prifddinas]]'s Ithell district for 250,000,000 coins. The crown is untradeable, and it cannot be alchemised or sold back to [[Lliann]]'s shop.

The crown’s colours, based on that of the Ithell Clan, may be changed to other colours of the Elven Clans. The crystals needed to do so can be bought from the same store for 500,000 coins each. It can also be reverted to the Ithell Clan's colour by using the [[crystal of Ithell]] on any variant of the crystal crown.

==Trivia==
* Attempting to cast [[Low Level Alchemy]] or [[High Level Alchemy]] on the crystal crown will display the message {{mes|You can't do that to the elven crystal!}}

It should be noted that Lliann's Wares initially carries three crowns in stock.  Each crown in stock is set to resupply after as many game ticks as it costs (250 million), which can take several years.  However, like all other shops, the stock refreshes back to three crowns after server restarts, such as maintenance or [[game updates]]. Due to the low number of players wishing to buy crystal crowns, the restock time should not be a concern.
